request.style: English, male solo voice with warm choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, hand drums, hopeful and steady mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
These are the people of the province who came up out of the captivity
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried them away
They returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own town
With Zerubbabel and Jeshua leading the way

[Verse]
When the seventh month came the Israelites were settled in their towns
The people gathered as one in Jerusalem to stand
Jeshua and Zerubbabel set to work with their kinsmen
To rebuild the altar of the God of Israel

[Chorus]
Settled in their towns, the families are registered
Restoring worship in the place God has blessed
The ears of all the people are attentive to the Law
We are one again, returning home

[Verse]
They set the altar on its foundations in dread of surrounding lands
Offering burnt offerings to the LORD both morning and evening
Ezra brought the Book of the Law to the square before the Water Gate
Reading from daybreak until midday to the men and women

[Chorus]
Settled in their towns, the families are registered
Restoring worship in the place God has blessed
The ears of all the people are attentive to the Law
We are one again, returning home

[Bridge]
The priests and Levites and the rest of the returned exiles
Celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy
Hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs
Twelve male goats for the tribes, sin offering complete

[Outro]
Installed in their groups for the service of God in Jerusalem
As prescribed in the book of Moses, we stand
